meta.title: Two bids: award all 10 units to Vendor A (not the lowest); no approval flow
gaps: A closed RFQ with two bids, including Vendor A at 100 and Vendor B at 90
Verifying Vendor A is selected specifically because it is not the lowest bidder
Allocating all 10 requested units and verifying the Awarded Vendors counter is 1/2
Filling and inspecting required proposal fields or recording whether a reason is requested for skipping L1
Verifying that no approval flow occurs
Verifying one PO per awarded vendor and that the event moves to History for the requested two-vendor award
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: A closed RFQ with two bids, including Vendor A at 100 and Vendor B at 90; Verifying Vendor A is selected specifically because it is not the lowest bidder; Allocating all 10 requested units and verifying the Awarded Vendors counter is 1/2; Filling and inspecting required proposal fields or recording whether a reason is requested for skipping L1; Verifying that no approval flow occurs; Verifying one PO per awarded vendor and that the event moves to History for the requested two-vendor award

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ's Master QCS; prepared-state plans must start here.
Open the awarding screen to inspect the available allocation flow.
Allocate the available line item to the available vendor in the prepared one-bid state.
Assert the allocation counters for the one-line, one-vendor prepared state; the requested 1/2 counter is not available.
Complete the available award proposal submission flow.
Assert that the award proposal was created and submitted.
Complete the available post-award flow and create the purchase order.
Assert that the resulting PO contains the prepared event's single awarded line item.
